WITH customer_country_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    c.CustomerId,
    c.Country,
    AVG(i.Total) as customer_avg
  FROM Invoice i
  JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
  WHERE c.Country IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.Country
),
country_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    Country,
    AVG(customer_avg) as country_average
  FROM customer_country_avg
  GROUP BY Country
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(country_average) as overall_average
  FROM country_avg
),
filtered_countries AS (
  SELECT 
    ca.country_average,
    oa.overall_average
  FROM country_avg ca
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE oa.overall_average IS NOT NULL
    AND ca.country_average > oa.overall_average
)
SELECT 
  AVG(country_average) as avg_country_average,
  AVG(country_average - overall_average) as avg_difference
FROM filtered_countries
